customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile is an employer client or an individual worker

name.meaning: legal business name of an employer, or the worker's full legal name, exactly as on file

phone.meaning: registered phone number: the worker's mobile number, or the employer program contact's direct line

email.meaning: registered email address: the worker's personal email, or the employer program contact's work email

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the worker's Social Security number, or of the employer's federal Employer Identification Number

date_of_birth.meaning: the worker's date of birth; empty for employers

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the worker's home address, or of the employer's billing address

agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement

customer_id.meaning: the employer holding the agreement (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the program tier held, as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the agreement (see the program charter lifecycle)

signed_date.meaning: date the agreement was signed; the start of the term

go_live_date.meaning: date the first payroll file was validated and workers could enroll; empty until live

closed_date.meaning: date the agreement terminated; empty until terminated

renewal_date.meaning: date the current term ends and renews automatically unless notice was given

fee_model.meaning: who pays workers' transfer fees: the worker, the employer for a sponsored number of transfers, or the employer under a per-worker monthly fee

configured_cap_percent.meaning: access percentage the employer configured for its workers

eligible_headcount.meaning: eligible employees on the latest monthly census

payroll_group_count.meaning: payroll groups (pay schedules or legal entities) set up on the program

payroll_provider.meaning: payroll system the program integrates with

remittance_method.meaning: how the employer remits deducted amounts

termination_notice_date.meaning: date written termination notice was received; empty when none

remittance_receivable.meaning: deducted amounts the employer currently owes Paystride: deduction schedules less remittances and provider-absorbed shortfalls, plus returned remittances

fee_receivable.meaning: program charges the employer currently owes: invoice lines and late charges less payments and credit memos

settlement_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the settlement entry

pay_date.meaning: pay date of the payroll run the entry concerns

payroll_group.meaning: payroll group code exactly as set up on the program (for example HRLY-BW-01)

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; schedules and remittance returns add to and remittances and provider-absorbed write-offs subtract from the remittance receivable; a shortfall notice states the shortfall and moves nothing

due_date.meaning: on a schedule, the remittance due date; on an employer-liable shortfall notice, the date its cure is due; empty otherwise

schedule_entry_id.meaning: for every entry except a schedule, the settlement_entry_id of the deduction schedule it settles or concerns; empty on schedules

related_entry_id.meaning: for a remittance return the remittance returned; for a write-off the shortfall notice written off; empty otherwise

remittance_method.meaning: method of a remittance or returned remittance; none otherwise

shortfall_reason.meaning: reason on a shortfall notice or write-off; unreported when the employer gave none in time; none otherwise

liability.meaning: who bears a shortfall; none on other entries

billing_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the billing entry

billing_month.meaning: calendar month the line bills or credits; for payments the month of the line paid

invoice_line.meaning: kind of charge billed, paid or credited

quantity.meaning: units billed on the line (workers, transfers, payroll groups or months); 1 on flat lines

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; invoice lines and late charges add to and payments and credit memos subtract from the fee receivable

due_date.meaning: date an invoice line or late charge is due; empty on payments and credits

related_entry_id.meaning: for a payment or credit memo the billing_entry_id of the line it settles; for a late charge the settlement_entry_id of the overdue deduction schedule or shortfall notice; for an ach_return_fee line the settlement_entry_id of the returned remittance; empty otherwise

credit_reason.meaning: reason on a credit memo; none otherwise

census_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the monthly census entry

eligible_headcount.meaning: eligible employees reported by the employer for the month

enrolled_active_workers.meaning: workers whose Access plan under the agreement was active on any day of the month

availability_percent.meaning: measured platform availability for the month

change_request_id.meaning: primary id of the program change request

request_type.meaning: what the employer asks to change

requested_cap_percent.meaning: requested access percentage on a cap change; 0 otherwise

requested_fee_model.meaning: requested fee model on a fee model change; none otherwise

requested_payroll_group_count.meaning: requested number of payroll groups on a payroll group change; 0 otherwise

requester_role.meaning: employer portal role of the person submitting

effective_date.meaning: date the change takes effect; empty until scheduled

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

paycard_program_id.meaning: primary id of the employer's Payroll Card Program

customer_id.meaning: the employer holding the program (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the package held, as the official full package name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the program (see the paycard charter lifecycle)

signed_date.meaning: date the program agreement was signed

launch_date.meaning: date the first payroll batch posted to cards; empty until launch

closed_date.meaning: date the program terminated; empty until terminated

funding_method.meaning: how the employer funds payroll batches

card_kit_inventory.meaning: unissued instant-issue card kits held at the employer's locations

termination_notice_date.meaning: date written termination notice was received; empty when none

funding_balance.meaning: balance of the employer's program funding account: funds received and credits less loads, returns and fees; may be negative after a returned funding payment

funding_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the funding ledger entry

entry_time.meaning: time funds were received for a funding receipt; 00:00 on other entries

pay_date.meaning: pay date of the batch the entry concerns; empty on entries not tied to a batch

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; receipts, returned-load and reversal credits and fee credits add to and returns, batches and fees subtract from the funding balance

card_count.meaning: cards loaded by a batch, or kits on a kit fee; 1 on other entries

batch_type.meaning: kind of payroll batch; none on other entries

funding_method.meaning: method of a funding receipt or return; none otherwise

fee_type.meaning: kind of fee debited or credited; none otherwise

credit_reason.meaning: why a fee credit was given; none otherwise

billing_month.meaning: month a monthly fee bills; empty on other entries

related_entry_id.meaning: the narrowest source: for a return the receipt returned, for a fee the batch, receipt, kit order or return that incurred it, for a fee credit the fee; empty otherwise

paycard_request_id.meaning: for a load reversal credit or reversal fee, the reversal request (foreign key -> paycard_requests); empty otherwise

card_txn_id.meaning: for a returned-load credit or load reversal credit, the worker card load concerned (foreign key -> card_transactions); empty otherwise

kit_order_id.meaning: primary id of the card kit order

ship_location.meaning: employer location name the kits ship to, exactly as set up on the program

paycard_request_id.meaning: primary id of the employer's program request

card_txn_id.meaning: for a load reversal, the single worker card load to reverse (foreign key -> card_transactions); empty otherwise

reversal_reason.meaning: why the load is erroneous; none otherwise

requested_amount.meaning: for a load reversal, the erroneous amount to recover, at most the load; 0.00 otherwise

requested_variant_name.meaning: for a package change, the package requested; none otherwise

requester_role.meaning: employer portal role of the person submitting

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

disburse_service_id.meaning: primary id of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service

customer_id.meaning: the employer holding the service (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the tier held, as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the service (see the disburse charter lifecycle)

activated_date.meaning: date business verification and the first deposit activated the service; empty until then

closed_date.meaning: date the service closed; empty until closed

auto_replenish.meaning: whether the employer authorized automatic replenishment debits

low_balance_alert_usd.meaning: balance below which the employer is alerted and, with auto_replenish, a replenishment debit is made

prefund_balance.meaning: prefunded money available to disburse: deposits, returned payouts and fee credits less returned deposits, payouts, fees and withdrawals; never negative

disburse_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the disbursement ledger entry

entry_date.meaning: date the entry was booked (Eastern Time calendar day)

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; deposits, returned payouts and fee credits add to and deposit returns, payouts, fees and withdrawals subtract from the prefund balance

daily_sequence.meaning: ordinal of the entry among the service's entries of the same event family booked on the same entry_date, starting at 1

payee_customer_id.meaning: on a payout or payout return, the worker paid (foreign key -> customers); empty otherwise

payee_employee_number.meaning: the worker's employee number exactly as on the employer's payroll file; empty on entries without a payee

disbursement_type.meaning: kind of pay disbursed; none on other entries

destination_type.meaning: where a payout was sent; none on other entries

delivery_minutes.meaning: minutes from submission to delivery confirmation of an instant payout; empty otherwise

funding_method.meaning: method of a deposit or returned deposit; none otherwise

deposit_source.meaning: whether a deposit was sent by the employer or debited automatically; none otherwise

fee_type.meaning: kind of fee or fee credited; none otherwise

credit_reason.meaning: why a fee credit was given; none otherwise

return_reason.meaning: why a payout came back; none otherwise

billing_month.meaning: month a monthly fee bills; empty otherwise

related_entry_id.meaning: the narrowest source: for a fee the payout, deposit or return that incurred it, for a fee credit the fee, for a payout return or recall the payout, for a deposit return the deposit; empty otherwise

disburse_request_id.meaning: primary id of the employer's service request

disburse_entry_id.meaning: for a recall, the single payout to recall (foreign key -> disburse_ledger); empty otherwise

requester_role.meaning: employer portal role of the person submitting

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

access_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the worker's Earned Wage Access Plan

customer_id.meaning: the worker who holds the plan (foreign key -> customers)

agreement_id.meaning: the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement under which the plan was enrolled (foreign key -> program_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: the plan tier currently held, as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (see the access charter lifecycle)

activated_date.meaning: date employer verification activated the plan; empty until then

closed_date.meaning: date the plan closed; empty while not closed

employee_number.meaning: the employee number the employer uses for this worker on its payroll file, exactly as on file

payroll_group.meaning: the employer payroll group code the worker is paid under, exactly as on the employer's payroll file

hire_date.meaning: hire date reported by the employer's payroll file; the basis of tenure

employment_status.meaning: employment status as last reported by the employer's payroll file

pay_frequency.meaning: the worker's pay frequency as reported by the employer

next_pay_date.meaning: payday that ends the current pay period; transfers of the current period carry this date as pay_date

outstanding_balance.meaning: amount currently owed on the plan: transfers plus fees less recoveries, write-offs, returns and fee reversals; a negative figure is a credit left by reversing an already recovered fee, applied against the next payday's amount due

card_recovery_authorized.meaning: whether the worker has given a standing authorization to recover unrecovered amounts from their Paystride Visa Payroll Card

level_effective_date.meaning: date the current tier took effect

access_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the access ledger entry

access_plan_id.meaning: plan the entry belongs to (foreign key -> access_plans)

entry_date.meaning: date the entry was booked (Eastern Time calendar day)

pay_date.meaning: payday of the pay period the entry belongs to; for transfers and fees the payday on which they are due for recovery, for recoveries, shortfalls and write-offs the payday whose amount they settle

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; its effect on the outstanding balance is fixed by event_type (transfers and fees add, recoveries, write-offs, returns and fee reversals subtract; a shortfall states the unrecovered amount and moves nothing)

daily_sequence.meaning: ordinal of a transfer among the plan's transfers booked on the same entry_date, starting at 1; 1 on every non-transfer entry

requested_time.meaning: time the worker confirmed a transfer; 00:00 on every non-transfer entry

delivered_date.meaning: date the transfer was confirmed delivered; empty until delivered and on non-transfer entries

delivery_minutes.meaning: minutes from the worker's confirmation to delivery confirmation of an instant transfer; empty for next-business-day transfers, undelivered transfers and non-transfer entries

related_entry_id.meaning: the narrowest source entry this entry points back to: for a fee or a transfer return the transfer's access_entry_id, for a fee reversal the fee's access_entry_id, for a card autorecovery or a write-off the shortfall's access_entry_id; empty on transfers, payroll and voluntary recoveries and shortfalls

delivery_speed.meaning: delivery speed of the transfer (copied onto its fee); none on other entries

destination_type.meaning: where the transfer was delivered (copied onto its fee); none on other entries

fee_type.meaning: kind of fee on a fee entry or reversed by a fee reversal; none otherwise

recovery_method.meaning: how a recovery was collected; none on other entries

reason_code.meaning: reason on shortfalls, write-offs, transfer returns and fee reversals; none on transfers, fees and recoveries

carryforward_pay_date.meaning: on a shortfall, the later payday to which the unrecovered amount is carried; empty when it is not carried

earnings_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the earnings entry

access_plan_id.meaning: plan the earnings accrue to (foreign key -> access_plans)

work_date.meaning: date the hours were worked; on a period close, the payday

pay_date.meaning: payday of the pay period the earnings belong to

earnings_source.meaning: what the earnings line represents, as reported by the employer feed

hours_worked.meaning: hours represented by the line; 0.00 for tips and period closes

gross_amount.meaning: gross earnings reported by the employer for the line; 0.00 where the employer reports net only and on period closes

net_basis.meaning: whether net_amount came from the employer or was estimated from gross; none on period closes

net_amount.meaning: accrued net earnings moved by the line, always greater than zero; syncs add to and corrections and period closes subtract from accrued net

closure_request_id.meaning: primary id of the plan closure request

access_plan_id.meaning: plan to be closed (foreign key -> access_plans)

request_status.meaning: state of the closure request: submitted by the desk, confirmed by the worker, withdrawn by the worker, completed when the plan closed

requested_date.meaning: date the worker asked for closure

effective_date.meaning: date the closure takes effect: the request date when nothing is outstanding, otherwise the first date after the outstanding balance reaches zero; empty until known

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

card_account_id.meaning: primary id of the worker's payroll card account

paycard_program_id.meaning: the employer Payroll Card Program under which the account was opened (foreign key -> paycard_programs)

variant_name.meaning: the card plan held, as the official full plan name; set by the employer's paycard package

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the card account (see the card charter lifecycle)

issued_date.meaning: date the account was opened and the first card issued

activated_date.meaning: date the cardholder activated the card; empty until then

closed_date.meaning: date the account closed; empty while not closed

card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the card currently issued on the account, exactly as printed

payroll_consent_date.meaning: date the worker gave the employer written, voluntary consent to receive wages on the card; empty if no consent is on file

first_deposit_date.meaning: posted date of the first load ever credited to the account; the start of the new-account period; empty before any load

block_reason.meaning: why the account is blocked; none when not blocked

card_balance.meaning: current available balance: loads, fee refunds and dispute credits less debits, fees and dispute credit reversals; never negative

card_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the card transaction

card_account_id.meaning: card account the transaction posted to (foreign key -> card_accounts)

txn_date.meaning: date the transaction was initiated or authorized

posted_date.meaning: date the transaction posted to the account; the date error-resolution outer limits count from

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; loads, fee refunds and dispute credits add to and debits, fees and dispute credit reversals subtract from the balance

daily_sequence.meaning: ordinal of the transaction among the account's transactions of the same event family posted on the same posted_date, starting at 1

load_source.meaning: origin of a load; none on other transactions

debit_type.meaning: kind of debit; none on other transactions

atm_network.meaning: ATM network of an ATM withdrawal, balance inquiry or decline (copied onto its fee); none otherwise

foreign_transaction.meaning: whether a debit was made in a foreign currency or processed outside the United States

atm_surcharge_usd.meaning: surcharge the ATM owner added to an out-of-network withdrawal, included in its amount; 0.00 otherwise

merchant_name.meaning: merchant, ATM operator or originator name exactly as it appears on the account history; empty for fees

fee_type.meaning: kind of fee on a fee, or the fee a refund returns; none otherwise

refund_reason.meaning: why a fee refund, fee correction or rebate was given; none otherwise

credit_kind.meaning: provisional on provisional credits and their reversals, final on final credits; none otherwise

related_txn_id.meaning: the narrowest source transaction: for a fee the transaction or service order that incurred it, for a fee refund or fee correction the fee, for a surcharge rebate the withdrawal, for a provisional credit reversal the provisional credit; empty otherwise

source_ref_id.meaning: reference of the originating record in another ledger: the early wage transfer, the employer payroll load batch or disbursement, the access recovery, or the employer reversal or recall request; empty otherwise

dispute_id.meaning: the dispute a provisional credit, final credit or provisional credit reversal belongs to (foreign key -> card_disputes); empty otherwise

service_order_id.meaning: primary id of the card service order

card_account_id.meaning: card account the order is for (foreign key -> card_accounts)

shipping_speed.meaning: delivery speed of a replacement card; none for history requests

history_months.meaning: months of history requested in a written history order; 0 on card orders

dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the card dispute

card_account_id.meaning: card account the dispute is on (foreign key -> card_accounts)

card_txn_id.meaning: the single disputed transaction (foreign key -> card_transactions)

dispute_reason.meaning: what the cardholder says is wrong

dispute_path.meaning: whether the dispute is an electronic fund transfer error under Regulation E or a merchant dispute pursued only as a Visa chargeback

notice_date.meaning: date the cardholder first gave notice of the error

notice_channel.meaning: how the first notice was given

written_confirmation_date.meaning: date written confirmation of an oral notice arrived; empty if none arrived

history_access_date.meaning: date the cardholder first electronically accessed, or was sent a written history, showing the disputed transaction

loss_learned_date.meaning: for an unauthorized transaction, the date the cardholder says they learned of the loss or theft; empty otherwise

disputed_amount.meaning: amount in dispute, at most the disputed transaction's amount

resolution_date.meaning: date the investigation concluded; empty while open

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

card_closure_request_id.meaning: primary id of the card account closure request

card_account_id.meaning: card account to be closed (foreign key -> card_accounts)

requested_date.meaning: date the cardholder asked to close

payout_method.meaning: how the remaining balance is paid out; none when the balance is zero

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

save_account_id.meaning: primary id of the worker's Paystride Save account

card_account_id.meaning: the Paystride Visa Payroll Card account the savings are linked to (foreign key -> card_accounts)

variant_name.meaning: the savings tier held, as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the account (see the save charter lifecycle)

opened_date.meaning: date the account was applied for

closed_date.meaning: date the account closed; empty until closed

round_up_multiplier.meaning: round-up multiplier the worker chose; 0 means round-ups are off

auto_save_percent.meaning: share of each payroll load the worker chose to auto-save; 0 means off

goal_amount.meaning: savings goal the worker set; 0.00 when none

save_balance.meaning: current balance: deposits, interest and bonuses less withdrawals and bonus clawbacks

save_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the savings ledger entry

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; deposits, interest and bonuses add and withdrawals and clawbacks subtract

daily_sequence.meaning: ordinal among the account's entries of the same family on the same entry_date

deposit_source.meaning: how a deposit was funded; none otherwise

withdrawal_destination.meaning: where a withdrawal went; none otherwise

interest_month.meaning: month an interest credit covers; empty otherwise

source_ref_id.meaning: the card transaction a deposit came from, or the bonus a clawback takes back; empty otherwise

save_request_id.meaning: primary id of the savings closure request

requested_date.meaning: date the worker asked to close

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

loan_account_id.meaning: primary id of the worker's Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan

agreement_id.meaning: the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement sponsoring the loan benefit (foreign key -> program_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: the loan tier, as the official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the loan (see the loan charter lifecycle)

funded_date.meaning: date proceeds were disbursed; empty until funded

closed_date.meaning: date the loan was paid off, charged off, declined or withdrawn; empty while open

next_installment_date.meaning: payday of the next scheduled installment; empty when none

loan_balance.meaning: amount owed: principal disbursed and accrued interest less payments and charge-offs

loan_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the loan ledger entry

amount.meaning: size of the movement, always greater than zero; disbursements, interest and payment returns add and payments and charge-offs subtract

installment_number.meaning: installment a payment or return relates to; 0 on other entries

payment_method.meaning: how a payment was made; none otherwise

interest_month.meaning: month an interest accrual covers; empty otherwise

related_entry_id.meaning: for a payment return the payment returned; empty otherwise

loan_request_id.meaning: primary id of the borrower's loan request

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record

customer_id.meaning: customer whose identity was verified (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed; never changes from true back to false

verified_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
